description: Calculator, math expression evaluator with exact decimal arithmetic. Evaluate a maths expression exactly with decimal arithmetic (0.1+0.2 = 0.3): + - * / ^ %, brackets, sqrt, abs, round(x, places), floor, ceil, ln, log, exp, sin, cos, tan, min, max, mod, pi, e. A safe parser: no code is run. Input: expr. Output: result (string, exact), number. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: math_eval
